scope: V.East bilingual dual-theme world-class frontend audit

checks.detail: 5 internal anchors resolve.
Exactly one H1.
Initial crawlable document is Arabic RTL.
Language switch updates HTML lang/dir.
Arabic and English catalogs include section and leadership content.
All core sections are represented in the bilingual catalog.
Featured places section is localized and grounded in the provided public venue details.
Facility selector has both language sets.
No Arabic UI copy is hardcoded outside the translation catalog.
WhatsApp messages follow current language and selected facility.
Title/description/OpenGraph/Twitter metadata update with locale.
Language preference persists and restores before paint.
Language names themselves localize with the active interface language.
AR/EN compact controls expose fully localized accessible names.
Dark/light theme is a real application state.
Theme persists and restores before paint.
First visit respects system color preference.
Video-inspired sun/moon/cloud/water theme scene is implemented without external animation assets.
Theme control exposes switch semantics and localized labels.
Theme transition uses progressive enhancement and reduced-motion fallback.
Light mode has a distinct restrained daylight palette.
Light primary contrast 13.36:1.
Light muted contrast 5.33:1.
Light teal contrast 5.67:1.
Light warm accent contrast 6.05:1.
Light CTA contrast 6.37:1.
Dark warm accent contrast 8.16:1.
Dark body contrast 11.87:1.
Dark-surface muted copy/icons use a dedicated readable value; 5.07:1 on brand navy.
Two-tone focus indicator retains >=3:1 visibility across representative dark, light and CTA surfaces.
OS high-contrast/forced-colors users receive stronger, non-decorative state separation.
Phone/tablet/laptop/desktop variants present.
Featured venues section is mounted near the top of the application.
Featured venue profiles open in an accessible modal dialog with Escape and keyboard focus trapping.
Venue profiles portal to document.body and isolate the background with inert while open.
Desktop navigation starts exactly where compact navigation ends; no 1280–1535 dead zone.
Desktop language/theme controls are reachable from the same xl breakpoint where the drawer disappears, with the brand descriptor compacted to preserve space.
The supplied-video idea is adapted as a measured active-section navigation pill, driven by real scrollspy state.
The moving navigation state includes a localized Home section rather than disappearing at page entry.
Active navigation motion inherits the global reduced-motion override.
The active navigation pill animates with compositor-friendly transform/opacity only.
Language controls meet the enhanced 44×44px touch target.
Narrow phone/mobile gates present.
Notched-device safe areas handled.
Primary controls retain touch-friendly source sizing.
Drawer direction follows LTR/RTL.
Mobile drawer has modal/inert/Escape behavior.
FAQ disclosure semantics intact.
CTA, skip-link, and drawer focus continuity present.
CSS and programmatic reduced-motion handling present.
Entrance removed for reduced-motion users.
No decorative infinite animation.
Primary motion uses transform/opacity.
No animated saturation/filter effects.
No persistent will-change hints.
Touch devices avoid sticky hover movement.
Motion is tied to content hierarchy and operating flow.
Entrance is a bounded branded micro-story with logo zoom-out, layered water, kinetic markers, localization, and a finite exit.
Rendered site imagery remains local.
Every image declares width and height.
Hero image prioritized.
Below-fold assets use lazy loading.
SEO/OpenGraph/structured data present.
Organization structured-data description/language follows the active Arabic/English experience.
Indexing policy explicit.
Known unsupported claims absent.
Approved phone/email preserved.
All approved Arabic service lines intact.
All service lines have deliberate English counterparts.
No unrelated AI/heavy motion stack.
No TODO/FIXME/HACK markers.
Restrained maritime/warm palette; no generic AI purple.
No AI watermark/generator residue in production source or metadata.
9/9 referenced assets exist.
